svg.title: One shared mask preserves row alignment
svg.desc: Applying one shared boolean mask valid = [T, F, F, T] keeps rows 0 and 3 aligned across dist, vel, and sigma, whereas separate per-column masks both return shape (3,) and silently pair row 2's velocity with row 1's sigma.

g.title: shared_mask
g.text: One shared mask preserves row alignment
